about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P550e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P550e is the flagship plug-in hybrid variant in the L460 generation, introduced from 2022. It uses the AJ300 turbo PHEV inline-six — a 3.0-litre petrol engine paired with a 105kW electric motor, with the P550e badge tracking the highest power output tier among the PHEV range. The engine code sits in the same Ingenium family as the other L460 six-cylinder variants, but the PHEV-specific hybrid components distinguish it from the mild-hybrid petrol and diesel versions. The Range Rover P550e remains in current production as of 2026. Land Rover Range Rover P550e Engine Codes AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol plug-in hybrid fitted to the Range Rover P550e from 2022 to present (L460 generation). The engine is paired with a 105kW electric motor, with the P550e badge representing the highest power output among the PHEV variants. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover P550e from 2023 to present. The AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 rebuild.
